stories.title: Hawarden Park Girls and Ladies FC submits new plans for first home pitch after refusal
stories.summary: Hawarden Park Girls and Ladies FC has submitted new plans for its first dedicated home pitch, after Flintshire County Council refused the first attempt in January. The club wants to turn about seven acres of farmland next to Hawarden Park Cricket Club on Moor Lane into a full-size football pitch and a second cricket ground.
